description: Cleanview's data centre tracker maps operating and planned data centres in the United States with capacity in megawatts, developer, status, year and state and county location. The page read on 2026-09-29 listed 3,564 facilities, of which 1,304 operate and 2,215 are planned, with combined capacity of 457,690 MW and 384 developers, and it was marked updated in September 2026. The provider is a commercial energy data company and the tracker is meant to show electricity load growth by grid region. Access is a free interactive map and tables plus a documented API; sign-in and paid plans exist and the page states no data licence beyond a copyright notice. Caveats: location is to county level, planned entries are announcements that may not be built, and bulk download terms need a plan. It suits capacity planning and load forecasting for power systems and studies of data centre concentration and grid stress. Related catalogue records: data-atlas-global-data-center-map, data-451-research-datacenter-knowledgebase and data-baxtel-data-center-directory.
